Welcome to the Office of Student Operations
Student Operations reports to the Associate Dean of Students and provides academic organizational support for the student population of the Graduate School. Responsibilities of our office include student arrival and orientation, the sponsorship program, student handbook/guidance, thesis/dissertation processing, and commencement ceremonies.
General Student Information
General information is found HERE
I am on Orders to Attend AFIT as a Full-Time Student and I Need Reporting Information
Congratulations on your selection to attend the Graduate School of Engineering and Management as a full-time student. We look forward to having you at AFIT and are sure this will be a memorable assignment. The following link will take you to the inbound student page with resources to help in the reporting process. You can find the inbound student page HERE.
I am a Military Student looking to start classes part-time
Whether you are here at Wright-Patterson, somewhere else around the world, or orbiting above it, we look forward to having you as a student. If you have already applied and received your letter of academic eligibility, you can find information on how to get started with classes HERE.
If you have not yet applied, or if you have applied and not yet received your eligibility letter, please start with the Admissions office https://www.afit.edu/ADMISSIONS/
I am a Department of the Air Force Civilian looking to start classes part-time
Thank you for choosing the Graduate School of Engineering and Management to further your education. If you have already applied and recieved your letter of academic eligibility, you can find information on how to get started with classes HERE.
If you have not yet applied, or if you have applied and not yet received your eligibility letter, please start with the Admissions office https://www.afit.edu/ADMISSIONS/
